intro.text: Welcome! This short video shows how a presentation video is built.
Nothing here is filmed. Every picture is drawn from a script.

steps.text: First you write the script: chapters, scenes and the sentences to speak.
Then each sentence is voiced, and its length is measured.
From those lengths the timeline is derived, so nothing is timed by hand.
Last, the video is rendered and the finished file is measured.

close.text: Change one sentence, and only that sentence is voiced again. Everything after it moves by itself.
That is all you need to start. Have fun building your first video!
